items.title: CodeQL 2.26.3 improves GitHub Actions queries and JavaScript modeling - GitHub Changelog
items.summary_zh: GitHub 发布 CodeQL 2.26.3，增强了 GitHub Actions 查询准确性，并扩展了 JavaScript/TypeScript/Vue 的源与数据流建模。更新包括识别 merge_group 事件中的不可信输入、支持以 file:<path> 方式为特定文件建模、为 Vue Composition API 与 Vue Router 增加远程流来源识别，以及对 Sails Action2 输入和 promise 包装响应数据的跟踪改进。
items.summary_en: GitHub released CodeQL 2.26.3 with better GitHub Actions query accuracy and expanded JavaScript/TypeScript/Vue source and data-flow modeling. Changes include recognizing untrusted input in merge_group events, supporting file-specific custom models via file:<path>, adding remote-flow modeling for Vue Composition API and Vue Router, and improving tracking for Sails Action2 inputs and promise-wrapped response data.
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这不是泛泛的产品发布，而是直接影响代码扫描误报/漏报、工作流安全检测覆盖率以及前端框架数据流分析质量的底层规则更新。对维护 CodeQL、自定义安全查询、或依赖 GitHub Advanced Security 的平台团队来说，这类小版本更新往往比大功能发布更能改变实际检测结果。
items.why_it_matters_en: This is not a generic product announcement; it directly affects false-positive/false-negative behavior in code scanning, workflow security coverage, and data-flow analysis quality for modern frontend stacks. For teams maintaining CodeQL, writing custom security queries, or depending on GitHub Advanced Security, these point releases often have outsized impact on real detection outcomes.
key_takeaways_zh: GitHub Actions 分析现在会把 github.event.merge_group 识别为不可信输入来源，有助于覆盖新的合并队列相关攻击面。
移除了 codeql.actions.security.SelfHostedQuery 模块；任何依赖该模块的自定义查询都需要迁移。
JavaScript/TypeScript 自定义模型现在可通过 file:<path> 精确指向文件公开导出，提升仓库内局部建模能力。
Vue ref/reactive/computed、Vue Router useRoute()、Sails Action2 inputs 与 promise 响应传播都获得了更好的污点/远程流建模。
key_takeaways_en: GitHub Actions analysis now treats github.event.merge_group as an untrusted source, improving coverage for merge-queue-related attack surfaces.
The codeql.actions.security.SelfHostedQuery module has been removed, so custom queries depending on it must be updated.
JavaScript/TypeScript custom models can now target public exports from specific files via file:<path>, enabling more precise repository-local modeling.
Vue ref/reactive/computed, Vue Router useRoute(), Sails Action2 inputs, and promise-wrapped response propagation all receive stronger taint/remote-flow modeling.

implications_en: Platform and security teams should rescan critical repositories and inspect alert deltas for GitHub Actions and JS/Vue codebases.
If your organization maintains custom CodeQL queries, check immediately for dependencies on the removed SelfHostedQuery module.
For AI coding agents, better repository- and framework-level data-flow modeling can improve the reliability of automated fixes, risk explanations, and review suggestions.
